stories.title: AI Solved Math’s Most Famous Problem. Now Humans Are Struggling to Understand It
stories.summary: It will take mathematicians months to understand the “alien” 17-million-line solution an Anthropic researcher produced for the Riemann hypothesis.
stories.zh_title: 人工智慧解決了最著名的數學問題。現在人類正在努力理解它
stories.zh_summary: 數學家需要幾個月的時間才能理解人類研究人員為黎曼假設提出的「外星」1700 萬行解。

stories.title: Signal joins United Airlines, banks in limiting AI agents over customer risks
stories.summary: Privacy-focused messaging application Signal has joined United Airlines and JPMorgan Chase in implementing restrictions around artificial intelligence agents.
stories.zh_title: Signal 與聯合航空公司和銀行一起限制人工智慧代理的客戶風險
stories.zh_summary: 專注於隱私的訊息應用程式 Signal 已與聯合航空和摩根大通一起實施對人工智慧代理的限制。

stories.title: Don’t Bring Up AI if You Want to Enjoy Your Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Young people anxious about their futures say they’re increasingly frustrated with their pro-AI parents. They’re worried it’s going to make holiday gatherings very tense.
stories.zh_title: 如果你想享受感恩節就不要提起人工智慧
stories.zh_summary: 對未來感到焦慮的年輕人表示，他們對支持人工智慧的父母越來越感到沮喪。他們擔心這會讓節日聚會變得非常緊張。

stories.title: The bull and bear surprises that could ambush investors next year, according to Bank of America
stories.summary: Michael Hartnett’s tactical masterplan is to stay risk off until global rate hikes start to dry up next spring. Thereafter, modest earnings growth and the chance of looser financial conditions in the second half favor owning cyclicals and adding more risk.
stories.zh_title: 美國銀行表示，明年的多頭市場和熊市意外可能會伏擊投資者
stories.zh_summary: 邁克爾·哈內特的戰術總體計劃是保持風險規避，直到明年春天全球升息開始停止。此後，溫和的獲利成長和下半年金融狀況寬鬆的可能性有利於持有週期性股票並增加更多風險。

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
stories.summary: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship，讓 AI 代理程式審查、修復和批准程式碼更改
stories.zh_summary: 隨著人工智慧生成的程式碼不斷堆積，Anthropic 的新開發工具旨在透過讓代理商處理例行審批來消除另一個瓶頸。

stories.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
stories.summary: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.
stories.zh_title: Supertake 融資 2000 萬美元，讓人工智慧代理商將你的市場預測轉化為股票投資組合
stories.zh_summary: 您認為您知道市場走向嗎？一家名為 Supertake 的新創公司可以讓你將資金投入你的想法中，而無需自己挑選股票。

stories.title: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation
stories.summary: The influential central banker expressed confidence that inflation will get closer to the Fed's 2% target in 2027.
stories.zh_title: 聯準會約翰威廉斯表示，「隨著時間的推移」可能會提高利率以應對通膨
stories.zh_summary: 這位頗具影響力的央行行長表示有信心通膨率將在 2027 年接近聯準會 2% 的目標。

stories.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
stories.summary: Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude's code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was […]
stories.zh_title: Claude AI 現在可以自行審查拉取請求並發布修復
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic 正在推出一些新的 Claude AI 功能來幫助軟體工程師交付程式碼。作為今天發布的新 Claude Ship 產品的一部分，Claude 現在可以審查、修復和批准拉取請求。工程師們已經能夠利用 Claude 的程式碼審查功能，這要歸功於

stories.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
stories.summary: By bringing Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, Google is leveraging the wealth of user data that's already within its ecosystem
stories.zh_title: 谷歌搜尋的人工智慧模式現在可以利用雲端硬碟和錢包來獲得更個人化的回應
stories.zh_summary: 透過將 AI 模式下的個人智慧引入 Drive、Wallet 和 Gemini 應用程序，Google 正在利用其生態系統中已有的豐富用戶數據

stories.title: Tokenized stocks face pushback as NYSE, Nasdaq pivot for a new market
stories.summary: OKXICE is set to debut Monday despite objections from 90% of the companies whose stocks it initially proposed to list.
stories.zh_title: 隨著紐約證券交易所和納斯達克轉向新市場，代幣化股票面臨阻力
stories.zh_summary: 儘管 90% 的最初擬上市公司表示反對，OKXICE 仍定於週一上市。

stories.title: Futures rally after Wall Street's nightmare week
stories.summary: Investors look to buy the dip as technology stocks lead early gains for the Nasdaq
stories.zh_title: 華爾街惡夢週後期貨上漲
stories.zh_summary: 由於科技股引領納斯達克指數早盤上漲，投資人希望逢低買入

stories.title: Asian Nvidia-related stocks jump after Huang's return, with Taiwan's near price limits
stories.summary: Investors piled back into the tech market, following the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang by its board.
stories.zh_title: 黃仁勳回歸後，亞洲英偉達相關股票大幅上漲，台灣接近漲停板
stories.zh_summary: 在英偉達董事會恢復執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 的職位後，投資者紛紛重返科技市場。

stories.title: Short sellers get smoked as Nvidia tallies biggest one-day gain in stock-market history
stories.summary: Two products aiming to profit off daily declines in Nvidia shares were nearly wiped out as the stock rallied more than 30%.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達創下股市史上最大單日漲幅，賣空者被燻
stories.zh_summary: 當英偉達股價上漲超過 30% 時，兩款旨在從英偉達股價每日下跌中獲利的產品幾乎被消滅。

stories.title: Amazon to acquire AI startup Decart's chip software, hire founders
stories.summary: Decart, founded in 2023, is best known for its software that lets developers sync their AI models across different chips.
stories.zh_title: 亞馬遜將收購人工智慧新創公司Decart的晶片軟體並聘請創辦人
stories.zh_summary: Decart 成立於 2023 年，以其讓開發人員在不同晶片上同步人工智慧模型的軟體而聞名。

stories.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
stories.summary: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round.
stories.zh_title: 隨著 CX 對 AI 的需求起飛，Sierra 估值在六個月內翻倍至 $30B
stories.zh_summary: 由 Salesforce 前聯合執行長 Bret Taylor 共同創立的企業客戶體驗公司 Sierra 週一表示，已在 F 輪融資中籌集了 17.5 億美元。
